commands.name: Pixel vertical -> 720p
commands.command: for /f "delims=" %a in ('ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream^=color_space -of default^=noprint_wrappers^=1:nokey^=1 "{input}"') do @if /I "%a"=="bt2020nc" (ffmpeg -i "{input}" -vf "scale=-2:720,colorspace=all=bt709:itrc=bt2020-10:iprimaries=bt2020:ispace=bt2020nc,format=yuv420p" "{output_dir}/{name}.mp4" -y) else (ffmpeg -i "{input}" -vf "scale=-2:720,format=yuv420p" "{output_dir}/{name}.mp4" -y)

commands.name: Pixel Horizontal -> 720p
